description: Words and mastery names for class titles: the title under your name made from what your classes do together. This mod holds the vanilla classes' words, the mastery names for every theme pair and the renown lines; each other mod brings words for its own classes. Turn titles on or off, and pick the style, in Mod Settings under Titles.
